counters.name: poll_calls
counters.semantics: Number of generated suspend-frame poll function invocations, including inline child polls.

counters.name: cooperative_yields
counters.semantics: Number of task.yield_now suspension boundaries that returned PENDING.

counters.name: frame_allocations
counters.semantics: Logical heap or slab allocations for coroutine frames after allocator warm-up; stack and embedded child frames do not count.

counters.name: frame_drops
counters.semantics: Started coroutine frames whose idempotent drop plan executed for the first time.

counters.name: peak_live_frames
counters.semantics: Maximum simultaneously started and not-yet-dropped coroutine frames.

counters.name: ready_queue_enqueues
counters.semantics: Successful ready-queue enqueue operations.

counters.name: ready_queue_dequeues
counters.semantics: Ready-queue entries removed for polling.

counters.name: ready_queue_saturations
counters.semantics: Ready-queue enqueue attempts rejected because the bounded owner-local FIFO was full.

counters.name: ready_queue_cancellations
counters.semantics: Ready-queue entries removed without polling because their owner-local structured task was cancelled.

counters.name: task_spawns
counters.semantics: Structured task.spawn operations executed, including attempts rejected by the bounded owner-local FIFO.

counters.name: publication_moves
counters.semantics: Compiler-known non-Copy publication moves whose source ownership bit transferred to a structured child.

counters.name: task_joins
counters.semantics: One-shot structured task.join operations started by their owning parent frame.

counters.name: join_suspensions
counters.semantics: Structured join poll boundaries that returned PENDING because the selected child was incomplete.

counters.name: task_cancellations
counters.semantics: Incomplete structured task frames transitioned exactly once to the cancelled terminal state.

counters.name: deadline_registrations
counters.semantics: Positive-duration structured task.deadline scopes successfully armed on the owner-local timer table.

counters.name: deadline_expirations
counters.semantics: Structured deadline scopes that completed their current suspend task with the stable timeout failure.

counters.name: deadline_cancellations
counters.semantics: Armed structured deadlines disarmed after normal fallthrough or task cancellation before expiry.

counters.name: timer_registrations
counters.semantics: Positive-duration sleep and deadline timers successfully registered with the current-thread executor.

counters.name: timer_expirations
counters.semantics: Registered owner-local timers that reached their monotonic deadline and were moved to the ready queue.

counters.name: timer_cancellations
counters.semantics: Armed owner-local timers disarmed by normal deadline fallthrough or idempotent coroutine-frame destruction before expiry.

counters.name: peak_live_timers
counters.semantics: Maximum simultaneously armed owner-local timer registrations.

counters.name: channel_constructions
counters.semantics: Successfully constructed channels when they first bind to the measured owner executor.

counters.name: channel_sends
counters.semantics: Successful measured sends, whether buffered or delivered by direct handoff.

counters.name: channel_receives
counters.semantics: Values delivered to measured receives, whether buffered or handed off directly.

counters.name: channel_buffered_sends
counters.semantics: Successful sends that publish a value into a bounded ring slot.

counters.name: channel_buffered_receives
counters.semantics: Successful receives that remove a value from a bounded ring slot.

counters.name: channel_direct_handoffs
counters.semantics: Successful sends transferred directly to the oldest linked receiver without occupying a ring slot.

counters.name: channel_send_suspensions
counters.semantics: Send operations linked to a full channel waiter FIFO and returned pending.

counters.name: channel_receive_suspensions
counters.semantics: Receive operations linked to an empty open channel waiter FIFO and returned pending.

counters.name: channel_wakeups
counters.semantics: Linked channel waiters successfully enqueued on their owner ready queue.

counters.name: channel_closes
counters.semantics: First open-to-closed transitions observed by the measured owner executor; repeated close calls do not count.

counters.name: channel_cancellations
counters.semantics: Active send or receive registrations cancelled and cleaned before normal resume completion.

counters.name: select_registrations
counters.semantics: Receive and timer operations registered as pending arms of a static owner-local task.select.

counters.name: select_immediate_wins
counters.semantics: Static task.select operations resolved synchronously by the first source-order ready arm.

counters.name: select_suspended_wins
counters.semantics: Suspended static task.select operations whose winning arm enqueued the owner frame exactly once.

counters.name: select_loser_cancellations
counters.semantics: Pending non-winning select arm registrations synchronously unlinked or disarmed after a winner claim.

counters.name: select_cancellations
counters.semantics: Pending select arm registrations cleaned because their owning select was cancelled before completion.

counters.name: live_channel_buffered_elements
counters.semantics: Ring-buffer elements currently owned by channels bound to the measured executor.

counters.name: peak_live_channel_buffered_elements
counters.semantics: Maximum simultaneous ring-buffer elements owned by channels bound to the measured executor.

counters.name: live_channel_send_waiters
counters.semantics: Send registrations currently linked to measured channel waiter FIFOs.

counters.name: peak_live_channel_send_waiters
counters.semantics: Maximum simultaneous linked send registrations in the measured executor.

counters.name: live_channel_receive_waiters
counters.semantics: Receive registrations currently linked to measured channel waiter FIFOs.

counters.name: peak_live_channel_receive_waiters
counters.semantics: Maximum simultaneous linked receive registrations in the measured executor.

counters.name: reactor_initializations
counters.semantics: Owner-local platform reactor instances initialized after the first operation must wait.

counters.name: reactor_waits
counters.semantics: Blocking entries into epoll, kqueue, or IOCP with a bounded timer-derived timeout.

counters.name: reactor_timeouts
counters.semantics: Reactor waits that returned because their bounded timeout elapsed without a completion.

counters.name: reactor_completions
counters.semantics: Normalized platform completion events returned by the owner-local reactor.

counters.name: reactor_errors
counters.semantics: Reactor initialization, wait, or shutdown failures observed by the measured executor.

counters.name: reactor_shutdowns
counters.semantics: Initialized owner-local platform reactor instances closed during root executor shutdown.

counters.name: live_reactors
counters.semantics: Owner-local platform reactor instances still open when metrics are exported.

counters.name: peak_live_reactors
counters.semantics: Maximum simultaneously initialized reactor instances in the measured current-thread executor.

counters.name: local_retain
counters.semantics: Non-atomic ARC retain primitive operations executed by the measured program.

counters.name: local_release
counters.semantics: Non-atomic ARC release primitive operations executed by the measured program.

counters.name: live_timers
counters.semantics: Current armed owner-local timer registrations at the observation point.
